definitions.gloss: home visit (by a teacher to a pupil's family)
definitions.explanation: A Japanese school custom in which a teacher visits each pupil's home, usually early in the school year, to meet the family and learn about the home environment.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}がある。
examples.english: There will be a home visit next week.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}で{家|いえ}に{来|き}た。
examples.english: The teacher came to our house for a home visit.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}の{前|まえ}に、{急|いそ}いで{部屋|へや}を{片付|かたづ}けた。
examples.english: My mother hurriedly tidied up the rooms before the home visit.

notes:
Compound of {家庭|かてい} (household) + {訪問|ほうもん} (visit). A familiar event in Japanese primary and junior-high schooling, typically held in spring. Takes する as a verb ({家庭訪問|かていほうもん}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭訪問|かていほうもん}がある: there is a home visit
- {家庭訪問|かていほうもん}の{日|ひ}: the day of the home visit
- {担任|たんにん}の{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}: home visit by the homeroom teacher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {面談|めんだん}: interview; one-on-one meeting — teacher and parent meet, but usually at the school
- {訪問|ほうもん}: a visit — the general word, with no school connotation
